title: The Pink Cell Trick
description: A short sample story used for testing.

shots.label: PINK CELL
shots.text: They painted the jail cell pink, and the fights stopped.

shots.label: THE TEST
shots.text: You see, a scientist wanted to know if a colour could calm people down.

shots.label: TWO WEEKS
shots.text: So the team tried it in one room and watched what happened.
Nobody in that room acted angry for weeks, and the word spread fast.

shots.label: SIMPLE FIX
shots.text: Other jails copied the idea, though later studies found the effect fades.
Sometimes a cheap trick works for a while, and then it stops.
